svg.title: It also implies the signed cubic remainder is little o, by dividing the order-four bound by g3 X and using gX →0. No full perturbative series is required for these assertions. Finally take the trace and expectation of (TR76). Since the aligned scalar is centered, T 0 is traceless and the unit has expectation one, one obtains es = s4⟨tr T⟩/4. Subtracting the selected- vacuum expectation instead gives the exact centered-field comparison
